## Summary

## Type of change
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Bug fix without statistical-core change
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Statistical-method change (requires new version + validation)

## Validation
- [ ] Tests added/updated where appropriate
- [ ] `R CMD check` completed
- [ ] No sensitive/raw restricted data committed
- [ ] v0.2.2 frozen tag/core not rewritten
